title: LearningAgentContractSchemas
description: Input/output contract schema bundle for the Learning Agent (proposes durable lessons, re-entering the pipeline at Stage 3/4 as Proposal kind=lesson). See /contracts/agents/learning-agent.md.

input.description: Admits the Learning Agent with a scoped learning objective and the evidence (run audits, human corrections, eval results) it may draw from.

learning_objective.description: Scoped objective for the lesson-learning pass.

evidence_refs.description: References to run audit summaries, human corrections, or eval results.
